scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: Orforglipron (oral GLP-1) receives expedited FDA approval in early 2027, unlocking needle-phobic patients and massive non-cold-chain global distribution
Retatrutide BLA submitted in Q1 2027 with ~24% bariatric-level weight loss data, cementing undisputed long-term incretin leadership
Lebanon, IN and Alzey manufacturing expansions reach full commercial validation ahead of schedule, eliminating backlog constraints
Bipartisan Treat and Reduce Obesity Act (TROA) unlocks broad Medicare Part D coverage for anti-obesity medications
Multiple expands to 32x reflecting generational compounder status and accelerating cash flow inflection

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro and Zepbound) volume grows >35% YoY in FY2027, crossing $65B combined annual run-rate
Realized net prices compress 8-12% due to commercial payer rebate escalation and Medicaid statutory mandates, offset by unit volume leverage
Retatrutide submitted Q1 2027; Orforglipron launches in early diabetic indications with phased obesity ramp
FDA permanent 503B Bulks List exclusion successfully shuts down mass-scale compounded tirzepatide copies, redirecting patients to branded Zepbound
Valuation stabilizes at 27x forward EPS, inline with normalized high-growth mega-cap biopharma peers

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Escalating gross-to-net price erosion (>20% price declines) as commercial insurers impose restrictive prior authorization criteria and employer opt-outs
Novo Nordisk CagriSema and next-gen competitors (Amgen MariTide, Viking VK2735) achieve favorable clinical differentiation and price competition
Manufacturing validation bottlenecks or fill-finish quality citations create intermittent regional inventory stock-outs
Intensified federal scrutiny on GLP-1 budgetary impact spurs aggressive statutory price negotiation and PBM rebate restructuring
Multiple de-rates to 20x as growth decelerates and obesity franchise commoditization narrative gains market traction
